name: Change of Base
expr: logₐ b = log b / log a

name: Fourier Series
expr: f(x) = a₀/2 + Σ(aₙcos nx + bₙsin nx)

name: Factor Theorem
expr: (x-a) is a factor of f(x) iff f(a)=0

name: Cayley's Theorem
expr: every group is isomorphic to a subgroup of a symmetric group

name: Bolzano-Weierstrass Theorem
expr: every bounded sequence has a convergent subsequence

name: Analytic Function Condition
expr: f satisfies Cauchy-Riemann everywhere in domain

name: Subgroup Test
expr: H≤G if ab⁻¹∈H for all a,b∈H

name: Ring Definition
expr: set with two operations (+, ×) satisfying ring axioms

name: Field Definition
expr: commutative ring where every nonzero element has a multiplicative inverse

name: Sylow's Theorem
expr: existence of subgroups of prime power order

name: Compactness
expr: every open cover has a finite subcover

name: Continuity in Topology
expr: preimage of every open set is open

name: Logarithmic Differentiation (concept)
expr: take ln of both sides before differentiating

name: Laws of Exponents - Power of Power
HCF and LCM Relation
expr: HCF × LCM = Product of two numbers

name: Sum of First n Natural Numbers
Sum of Squares of First n Numbers
Sum of Cubes of First n Numbers
Nature of Roots (Discriminant)
expr: D>0 real distinct, D=0 real equal, D<0 complex

name: Formation of Quadratic Equation
expr: x² − (Sum of roots)x + Product of roots = 0

name: Angle of Elevation/Depression (concept)
expr: angle from horizontal to line of sight

name: L'Hopital's Rule
expr: lim f/g = lim f'/g' (0/0 or infinity/infinity form)

name: Implicit Differentiation (concept)
expr: differentiate both sides w.r.t x treating y as f(x)

name: Concavity Test
expr: f''(x) > 0 concave up, f''(x) < 0 concave down

name: Related Rates Setup (concept)
expr: differentiate a relating equation w.r.t time

name: Conjugate of Complex Number
expr: z̄ = a − bi, for z = a+bi

name: Domain and Range (concept)
expr: Domain = set of inputs, Range = set of outputs

name: Bisection Method (concept)
expr: root between a,b when f(a)f(b)<0, bisect repeatedly

name: Number of Relations on a Set
Number of Functions A to B
Pigeonhole Principle (concept)
expr: n+1 items into n boxes means one box has 2+ items

name: Supremum (concept)
expr: least upper bound of a set

name: Infimum (concept)
expr: greatest lower bound of a set

name: Sandwich (Squeeze) Theorem
expr: if g(x)<=f(x)<=h(x) and lim g=lim h=L then lim f=L

name: Rolle's Theorem
expr: if f(a)=f(b) then there exists c in (a,b) with f'(c)=0

name: Intermediate Value Theorem
expr: if f continuous on [a,b], f takes every value between f(a) and f(b)

name: Absolute Convergence (concept)
expr: series converges if sum of |an| converges

name: Lagrange's Theorem (Order)
expr: order of subgroup divides order of group

name: Normal Subgroup Condition
expr: gNg⁻¹ = N for all g in G

name: Galois Group (concept)
expr: group of automorphisms of a field extension fixing the base field

name: Ideal Definition (concept)
expr: subring closed under multiplication by ring elements

name: Euclidean Domain (concept)
expr: integral domain with a division algorithm

name: Simplex Method (concept)
expr: iteratively moves along vertices of feasible region to optimize Z

name: Convexity Condition
expr: f''(x) >= 0 for all x in interval

name: Gauss Elimination (concept)
expr: reduce augmented matrix to row echelon form

name: Gauss-Seidel Method (concept)
expr: iterative method using latest updated values

name: Regula Falsi Method (concept)
expr: linear interpolation between f(a) and f(b) to find root

name: nth Term from End of AP
Geometric Mean Insertion
expr: G = sqrt(ab) between a and b

name: General Solution sin x = sin a
General Solution cos x = cos a
General Solution tan x = tan a
Euler's Path Condition
expr: graph has 0 or 2 vertices of odd degree

name: Kruskal's Algorithm (concept)
expr: greedily add smallest edge avoiding a cycle to build MST

name: Nash Equilibrium (concept)
expr: a set of strategies where no player can benefit by changing their strategy alone, given others' choices

name: Payoff Matrix (concept)
expr: a table showing the outcomes/payoffs for each player based on the combination of strategies chosen

name: Dominant Strategy (concept)
expr: a strategy that yields a better outcome for a player regardless of what the opponent does

name: Zero-Sum Game (concept)
expr: a game where one player's gain is exactly equal to another player's loss

name: Expected Payoff (Mixed Strategy)
expr: E(Payoff) = Σ(Probability of Strategy × Payoff of Strategy)

name: Prisoner's Dilemma (concept)
expr: a classic game showing how two rational players may not cooperate even when it is in their mutual best interest

name: Vandermonde's Identity
expr: C(m+n, r) = Σ C(m, k) × C(n, r−k)

name: Stirling Numbers of the Second Kind (concept)
expr: count the number of ways to partition a set of n objects into k non-empty subsets

name: Tautology (concept)
expr: a compound proposition that is true under every possible truth assignment

name: Contradiction (Logic) (concept)
expr: a compound proposition that is false under every possible truth assignment

name: Logical Equivalence
expr: two statements p and q are logically equivalent if p ↔ q is a tautology

name: Universal Quantifier
expr: ∀x P(x) means "P(x) is true for all values of x"

name: Existential Quantifier
expr: ∃x P(x) means "there exists at least one x for which P(x) is true"

name: Rules of Inference — Modus Ponens
expr: from p → q and p, we can conclude q

name: Rules of Inference — Modus Tollens
expr: from p → q and ¬q, we can conclude ¬p

name: Proof by Contradiction (concept)
expr: assumes the negation of a statement and derives a logical contradiction, proving the original statement true

name: Fractal Dimension (concept)
expr: a non-integer measure describing how a fractal pattern's detail changes with the scale at which it is measured

name: Logistic Map
expr: xₙ₊₁ = r × xₙ × (1 − xₙ), a simple equation exhibiting chaotic behavior for certain values of r

name: Sensitive Dependence on Initial Conditions (concept)
expr: small differences in a system's starting state can lead to vastly different outcomes over time (the "butterfly effect")

name: Mandelbrot Set (concept)
expr: the set of complex numbers c for which the sequence z² + c remains bounded, producing a famous fractal shape

name: Self-Similarity (concept)
expr: a property where a fractal pattern looks similar to itself at different levels of magnification

name: Strange Attractor (concept)
expr: a set of values toward which a chaotic dynamical system tends to evolve, without ever repeating exactly

name: Bifurcation (concept)
expr: a sudden qualitative change in a dynamical system's behavior as a parameter is varied
